benefits.name: Anniversary Bonus Points
benefits.description: 7,500 Rapid Rewards bonus points each account anniversary year.

benefits.name: Companion Pass Qualifying Points Boost
benefits.description: 10,000 Companion Pass qualifying points each calendar year.
benefits.terms: One boost of 10,000 Companion Pass qualifying points per calendar year. Counts toward Companion Pass qualification only; does not add redeemable points.

benefits.name: A-List Tier Qualifying Points from Spend
benefits.description: 2,500 tier qualifying points toward A-List status for each $5,000 spent annually.
benefits.terms: Earn 2,500 TQPs for every $5,000 in purchases each year, applied toward A-List status qualification.

benefits.name: First Checked Bag Free
benefits.description: First standard checked bag free for the primary Cardmember and up to 8 additional passengers on the same reservation.
benefits.terms: Applies to Southwest-operated flights. Weight and size limits apply.

benefits.name: Group 5 Boarding
benefits.description: Group 5 boarding for the primary Cardmember and up to 8 additional passengers on the same reservation.

benefits.name: Complimentary Preferred Seat
benefits.description: Complimentary Preferred seat selection at booking, when available.
benefits.terms: Subject to availability at time of booking.

benefits.name: Extra Legroom Seat Upgrades
benefits.description: Unlimited complimentary upgrades to an Extra Legroom seat within 48 hours prior to departure, when available.
benefits.terms: Available within 48 hours before departure, subject to availability.

benefits.name: 25% Back on Inflight Purchases
benefits.description: 25% back as a statement credit on inflight drink and Wi-Fi purchases made with the card on Southwest flights.
benefits.terms: Purchases must be made with the card on Southwest-operated flights.

benefits.name: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged, or stolen checked or carry-on luggage.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases when checked luggage is delayed.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days, up to $500 per item.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 3 years or less by an additional year.

earningRates.terms: Purchases made directly with Southwest Airlines, including flights, inflight purchases, and Southwest gift cards.
